data.narrative:
Xage Security, a Series B-stage defense and security company, has raised $80M to date across its founding team of Kamesh Raghavendra, Susanto Irwan, and Roman Arutyunov. The valuation analysis draws from a comparable universe of 10 peers—2 public (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private companies operating in Defense & Security at similar stages.

Two valuation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis, using the $80M total raised as a baseline proxy and applying a 1.9x multiplier typical for Series B advancement, yields $152M. Peer-median analysis examines 7 same-sector, same-stage private comparables including Dream Security ($3.0B), Harmattan AI ($1.4B), Code Metal ($1.2B), Castelion ($1.0B), and Defense Unicorns ($1.0B), producing a median implied valuation of $1.0B with a range spanning $300M to $3.0B.

Triangulating these two methods produces a valuation range of $129M (low) to $1.1B (high), with a median of $576M. The wide spread reflects material dispersion in peer valuations—a 10x range from floor to ceiling. Key uncertainties include revenue scale and growth trajectory relative to the peer set, customer concentration and contract longevity in the defense sector, and the degree to which Xage's technology and market position align with the highest-valued comparables rather than mid-range peers.
